title: Coverage pass 3 N3-1 (ZZ-M1): a student living at home whose college meal plan provides most of her meals is in no SNAP household
comment: Coverage pass 3 N3-1 (the reviewer's scratch ZZ-M1). CO-193 with p2, the half-time college student of 25 employed 82 hours,
living at home (residence_setting_type private_dwelling) with a meal plan bought through her college that provides more than half
of her meals (has_higher_education_meal_plan_providing_majority_of_meals true). Hand derivation, October 2026:
- 4.304.4.D.3: a student whose meal plan provides more than 50% of her meals is a resident of an institution; no 4.304.41
exemption applies (a private dwelling, not a shelter, treatment centre or group living arrangement): CO-007 true.
- She states no institution_entry_date (CO-008 is stated only for a setting other than a private dwelling); the meal-plan arm
does not need it: p2 is in no SNAP household, participation not_in_household.
- p1 is past the ABAWD time limit (CO-87's facts): ineligible member. No eligible member remains: no_eligible_members, allotment 0.
Before the fix CO-304 read the entry date for p2 as well, and every SNAP outcome of the household was null (unknown).

title: Coverage pass 3 N3-2 (ZZ-D3): a sponsored permanent resident whose household declines to document her status - no sponsor deeming for her citizen son's household
comment: Coverage pass 3 N3-2 (the reviewer's scratch ZZ-D3). CO-116's sponsored permanent resident p2, earning $2,400 in wages, with her
citizen son p4 (10) in her unit; her brother p1 signed the I-864 (sponsor income $5,000, savings $3,000; his wife p3 did not sign).
The household says p2's status documentation will not be provided (declines_to_provide_immigration_documentation, 4.505.6.J).
Hand derivation, October 2026:
- 4.505.6.J: p2 is an ineligible non-citizen (CO-310); 4.305.2.C: "Only when a sponsored non-citizen is an eligible non-citizen"
is the sponsor's income and resources considered, so nothing is deemed (CO-3701, CO-3702 0) and no sponsor verification is
pursued (CO-1616 false).
- 4.411.1.B.2: p2's wages are prorated to the remaining member: 2,400 x 1/2 = 1,200 gross; eligible size 1.
- Earned income deduction 20% = 240; standard 217; adjusted 743. Shelter 1,366; excess 1,366 - 371.50 = 994.50, capped at 769.
Net 743 - 769 -> 0. Allotment 306 (maximum for 1) - 0 = 306. Resources p2 200 + p4 200 = 400.
Before the fix: deemed income 212.50 and resources 750 were attributed, gross 1,306, resources 1,150, allotment 282, and the
sponsor's verification was required.

title: Coverage pass 3 C3-1: a homeless father whose only income is a $1,000 vocational training allowance - counted as earned income and verified
comment: Coverage pass 3 C3-1. CO-115 with no wages; p1 receives a $1,000 vocational training allowance (not WIOA) each month, stated in
other_unearned_income_taxable with its part workforce_program_payments_received and vocational_training_allowance_received.
Hand derivation, February 2027:
- 4.403.B.1: a training allowance other than WIOA is earned income: earned 1,000 (CO-4930, CO-330); gross 1,000.
- Earned deduction 200, standard 217: net 583; no shelter cost. Allotment 562 - 175 (30% of 583, rounded up) = 387.
- 4.506: counted gross nonexempt income is verified before certification: earned-income verification required (true).
Before the fix the verification item read wages only and was false; the budget is unchanged (387).

title: Coverage pass 3 C3-2: CO-195's recertification with a $500 training allowance as well - unchanged income is not a change
comment: Coverage pass 3 C3-2. CO-195's recertification (p1 paid $250 weekly, five Fridays in February, same source) with a $500 non-WIOA
training allowance as well, and $1,575 last verified for SNAP (snap_income_at_last_certification, CO-1568). Hand derivation:
- SNAP's wages 250 x 4.3 = 1,075 plus the allowance, earned income under 4.403.B.1: 1,575 (snap_person_earned_income); no
unearned income remains. 1,575 - 1,575 = 0, not more than $50, same source (273.2(f)(8)(i)(A); 4.506): no change, and earned
income is not verified again.
Before the fix CO-1619 compared wages alone (1,075) with 1,575: a change of 500, so verification was required.

title: Coverage pass 3 C3-3: questionable home-equity loan payments as the only shelter cost are verified, and left out when still unverified
comment: Coverage pass 3 C3-3. CO-115 with $400 a month of payments on a home-equity loan (shelter_other_continuing_charges, 4.407.3.E) as
the only shelter cost, and the statement questionable; no shelter document has been received. Hand derivation, February 2027:
- 4.507.B.1: the declaration is accepted "unless questionable": verification required (true), requested 2026-11-02, pending.
- 4.507.B.3: still unverified after the thirtieth day, the cost is left out: shelter costs 0, net 583, allotment 387 as in CO-115.
Before the fix verification was not required and the $400 was counted: net 377, allotment 448.

title: Coverage pass 3 C3-4: $400 of unemployment compensation paid weekly, five payments in January, is converted by 4.3
comment: Coverage pass 3 C3-4. CO-115 with no wages; p1 is paid $400 of unemployment compensation every week, five Fridays in January 2027
($2,000 received; periodic_unearned_income_frequency weekly, periodic_unearned_income_per_payment 400). Hand derivation, January:
- 4.402.A.2: weekly income is converted by 4.3: 400 x 4.3 = 1,720 unearned; gross 1,720.
- Standard deduction 217; no earned income or shelter cost: net 1,503. Allotment 562 - 451 (30% of 1,503, rounded up) = 111.
Before the fix weekly was not a statable frequency and the five payments counted as received: gross 2,000, net 1,783, allotment 27.

title: Coverage pass 3 C3-5: $6,000 in the bank of which $2,000 is federal disaster assistance still held - countable resources 4,000
comment: Coverage pass 3 C3-5. CO-115 with $6,000 in the bank, $2,000 of it federal disaster assistance still held
(excluded_government_payments_held_value). Hand derivation: 4.410.J.3 excludes payments precipitated by a major disaster as a
resource: countable liquid 6,000 - 2,000 = 4,000, the household's countable resources 4,000 (under the $4,750 limit where a
resource test applies; this household is expanded categorical). Before the fix the whole 6,000 was counted.
